build_ovis2_image_processor: build an OVIS2 image processor that resizes, normalizes, and optionally crops images into patches for multimodal model input
crop_image_to_patches: crop an image into multiple patches using covering area grid or optimal tiled canvas strategy
get_optimal_tiled_canvas: get the optimal tile grid arrangement that matches the original image aspect ratio within a tile count range
get_min_tile_covering_grid: compute the minimum tile grid that covers at least 90% of the image area for a given patch size
get_all_supported_aspect_ratios: get all supported width-height tile aspect ratios within a minimum and maximum tile count range
